title: borreria latifolia var. scabrida
intro: Borreria latifolia var. scabrida, commonly known as the rough-leaved borreria, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional medicine, where it is used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Borreria latifolia var. scabrida include its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antimicrobial properties, which make it effective in treating wounds, skin infections, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antitumor, and hepatoprotective properties.
